events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: He's not the Messiah, he's a very naughty boy! Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as 'The White Album', 58 years ago on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles gave us the legendary 'White Album'. Double album, double the hits. Which track is your go-to?

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: We remember the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away 35 years ago today.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, 35 years on. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy – truly one of a kind. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', 61 years ago today.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles took us on a new musical journey with 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that changed everything. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: We remember the legendary Beatles co-founder, John Lennon, who passed away 46 years ago today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's the Lennon track that means the most to you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The iconic 'Starman' David Bowie, born in 1947, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie Tribute
angles.copy: Thinking of the one and only David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. A true innovator and legend. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, born in 1935, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: All shook up for The King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. His music still moves us. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: The legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer, Jimmy Page, born in 1944, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Jimmy Page Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the guitar wizard, Jimmy Page! The man behind some of rock's greatest riffs. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic rock and pop singer, Rod Stewart, born in 1945, celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rod Stewart Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! From rock anthems to classic crooning, what's your top Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: The charismatic frontman of Madness, Suggs (Graham McPherson), born in 1961, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Suggs Birthday
angles.copy: It must be love! Happy 66th birthday to the Nutty Boy himself, Suggs from Madness. What's your favourite Madness tune?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The English singer-songwriter Paul Young, born in 1956, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Paul Young Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! Still going strong. What's your favourite track from the man with the soulful voice?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music icon, Dolly Parton, born in 1946, celebrates her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Dolly Parton Birthday
angles.copy: Here you come again! Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Queen of Country, Dolly Parton. What's your favourite Dolly classic?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: The Take That frontman and singer-songwriter, Gary Barlow, born in 1971, celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Gary Barlow Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! From boyband hits to solo success, what's your favourite Gary track?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: The Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, born in 1950, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Billy Ocean Birthday
angles.copy: Get out of my dreams, get into my car! Happy 77th birthday to the brilliant Billy Ocean. What's your top tune from him?

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame's first induction was 41 years ago
events.blurb: The first ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held 41 years ago on January 23, 1986, honouring pioneers like Elvis Presley and Chuck Berry.

angles.name: Rock Hall Of Fame Anniversary
angles.copy: Forty-one years ago, the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame opened its doors to its first legends. Who do you think deserves a spot in the Hall?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: The Take That singer-songwriter, Mark Owen, born in 1972, celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Mark Owen Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! From boyband heartthrob to solo artist, what's your favourite Mark moment?

events.title: The Beatles' rooftop concert was 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their iconic final live performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters 58 years ago today.

angles.name: Beatles Rooftop Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles gave us their legendary rooftop concert. What an iconic way to say goodbye to live performances. What's your favourite track from that day?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: The legendary Genesis drummer and solo artist, Phil Collins, born in 1951, celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Phil Collins Birthday
angles.copy: Sussudio! Happy 76th birthday to the one and only Phil Collins. What's your go-to Phil track?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: The Grammy-winning singer, songwriter, and actor, Justin Timberlake, born in 1981, celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Justin Timberlake Birthday
angles.copy: It's gonna be May! Oh wait, it's January 31st! Happy 46th birthday to Justin Timberlake. What's your favourite JT hit?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: The beloved British actor, Sir David Jason, born in 1940, known for iconic roles like Del Boy and Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: David Jason Birthday
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason. What's your favourite role of his?

events.title: The Day The Music Died: 68 years on
events.blurb: We remember Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper, who tragically died in a plane crash 68 years ago today, an event known as 'The Day The Music Died'.

angles.name: Day Music Died Tribute
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago, the music world lost three incredible talents in one tragic day. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. Their legacy lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: The English singer-songwriter Rick Astley, born in 1966, famous for 'Never Gonna Give You Up', celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Rick Astley Birthday
angles.copy: Never gonna give you up, never gonna let you down! Happy 61st birthday to the legend that is Rick Astley. What's your favourite Rick hit?

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: The reggae icon Bob Marley, born in 1945, would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Bob Marley Tribute
angles.copy: One Love. Remembering the legendary Bob Marley, who would have turned 82 today. His message and music resonate as strongly as ever. What's your favourite Marley track?
